translated: I see photos of these super photogenic shaved ice treats on social media all the time, but I've never actually said, "I want to go to this shop."
Some people really go around to all these different shaved ice shops, and...
It's not just the usual strawberry syrup. Apparently, they have things like pumpkin cream or even vegetable-based ones.
People who love it will even eat it in the winter.
Shaved ice in the winter sounds nice too.
It's like eating ice cream in a warm room.
I should give it a try.
Did you go to any festivals?
I haven't even stumbled across one by accident this year.
I actually went to a fireworks festival, so I've been enjoying summer to the fullest.
That sounds like so much fun.
But even then, I just looked at the shaved ice and didn't eat any.
Ah, right, they have the food stalls and everything.
But when I went to Hokkaido like I mentioned earlier, I did eat that famous treat where they put soft serve on a melon.
